name: gielinor-companion-mcp
description: An open-source, AI-compatible RuneScape 3 quest, levelling and Grand Exchange companion.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/shared-types build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/providers build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/database build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/mcp-server build
scripts.test:unit: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/core/test packages/providers/test apps/mcp-server/test/schemas.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp: corepack pnpm build && vitest run apps/mcp-server/test
scripts.test:providers: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/providers/test
scripts.test:database: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/database/test
scripts.test:live: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs all
scripts.test:live:hiscores: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs hiscores
scripts.test:live:itemdb: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs itemdb
scripts.test:live:wiki: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs wiki
scripts.test:live:training: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs training
scripts.test:live:prices: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs prices
